data.title: Microsoft plays the Windows card in the AI game, with help from Nvidia
data.description: At an event in San Francisco, Microsoft announced features that will let Copilot read the files on a PC, take actions on the machine and run AI models locally instead of in the cloud. New PCs built around an Nvidia chip, including a $2,599 Surface laptop, start shipping Oct. 16.
data.author: Todd Bishop
